# Appearance

Technical reference for **Settings / Interface / Appearance**. The app shows a short summary;
this page keeps the full detail.

## Appearance (page help)

Dark is Moguri's factory theme. This preference is shared by SDK clients (desktop and TUI); the desktop
resolves System against the operating system.

## Custom element colors

Custom colors apply when Custom is selected and save when you pick a color. Saving validates text,
control, focus, selection and semantic contrast in both Dark and Light modes; unreadable combinations
are rejected, not silently replaced.
